name: algebra
title: Algebra
scope: This card solves linear, system, exponent, and quadratic questions from the coefficients and points already given.
method: Classify the problem as a line, a system, a polynomial, or a quadratic.
Copy the given coefficients, points, and equations without filling blanks.
For two points with different x-values, compute the slope, then write y = mx + b.
For a system, use substitution or elimination and satisfy every equation.
For ax^2 + bx + c = 0 with a not zero, compute the discriminant, then the quadratic formula.
Substitute the result into the original equation before stating it.

formulas.name: Slope
formulas.use: Slope is the change in y divided by the change in x between two points.

formulas.name: Slope-intercept form
formulas.use: A line with slope m crosses the y-axis at b.

formulas.name: Quadratic formula
formulas.use: Gives the roots of ax^2 + bx + c = 0 when a is not zero.

formulas.name: Discriminant
formulas.use: A positive value means two real roots, zero means one real root, and a negative value means no real roots.

formulas.name: Exponent product rule
formulas.use: Multiplying powers of the same base adds the exponents.

checks: Slope is undefined when x2 = x1; do not divide by zero.
The quadratic formula needs a ≠ 0; a zero leading coefficient is a linear equation.
A positive discriminant gives two real roots, zero gives one, and a negative gives none in the reals.
a^m * a^n = a^(m+n) only when the bases match; the product is not a^(mn).
limits: The quadratic formula finds roots, not the vertex by itself.
A system contains only the equations written down, not extra constraints.
This card does not supply a coefficient, point, or exponent the user did not give.
